name: video-kit
title: Video Kit
description: The Better Design video kit: the theme every video component paints from, shared easing and springs, colour helpers that read any CSS colour, oklch() included, and mix in OKLab, a caret, a text field, phone and laptop frames drawn from real hardware measurements, and sound: cues, a mixer and a SoundTrack that plays the CC0 Better Design sound pack. The install command for any component brings it in.
docs: Written by Better Design. Pass the product's tokens through the theme prop so the film matches the app.
